name: Susumi
source:
"Wh-What are you looking at? Don't look at me! Please leave!"

This NPC is an elf shrine maiden who lives deep in the forest, apparently protecting an important place, but there seems to be no end to the number of intruders. You may think it's a lot of work for such a little girl, but rest assured, it's not. 
Unlike the students at the school, she is an NPC and an elf. In other words, her appearance has nothing to do with her actual age. So, please don't worry. Despite appearances, Susumi is an adult! 
Now, let's also mention the fact that she is a shrine maiden. She can talk to spirits, but..... it just looks like she is talking to herself. It's so surreal and endearing, it's worth a look! Well, if you actually see her, she will say cute lines like the one at the top as an example!

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Elf
Height: 122 cm
Occupation: Shrine Maiden
